label: Political Prisoners
contestNote: Foro Penal counted 391 political prisoners still detained (228 civilians, 163 military) as of mid-August, after the government freed 131 more in a mid-August release tied to the transition talks — independently verified at ~43 by Vente Venezuela and 'at least 40' by Foro Penal. That release brought total releases since Maduro's January 3 detention to roughly 1,046 per government/opposition tallies. US Secretary of State Rubio called the release 'a crucial step' for reconciliation; opposition figure Juan Pablo Guanipa demanded all remaining prisoners be freed 'without exception, without delay.'
delta: −1,046 released since Jan 3, 2026 capture; 391 still detained per Foro Penal

deltaNote: Largest single source of household income for many families

label: Earthquake Death Toll (Jun 24 quakes)
contestNote: USGS PAGER modeling initially projected a potential toll above 10,000; a UN estimate put ~50,000 people still missing as of late July; only 28.61% of debris had been cleared as of Aug 25, according to Rodríguez; government figures are self-reported without independent verification. Only 335 of the 4,000 promised replacement homes had been delivered as of mid-August, and an August 22 flash flood — unrelated to the earthquakes but striking the same recovering region — killed one more person and left six missing.
